'''2018 EGP David Beaubier DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Beaubier]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David Beaubier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Beaubier DS 2018 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127135112/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
